mapper.sql: select k.task_id, k.trigger_id, t.trigger_name, k.agent_code, k.action, k.source_event_id, cast(k.playbook_codes as text) as playbook_codes, k.target_type, k.target_id, k.channel, k.dedup_key, cast(k.payload as text) as payload, k.status, k.scheduled_time, k.expire_time, k.attempts, k.max_attempts, k.claim_token, k.started_time, k.finished_time, cast(k.result as text) as result, k.error_msg, k.create_by, k.create_time, k.update_by, k.update_time from abr_growth_task k left join abr_growth_trigger t on t.trigger_id = k.trigger_id
mapper.select: select status as "status", count(*) as "count" from abr_growth_task group by status order by status
mapper.insert: insert into abr_growth_task (trigger_id, agent_code, action, source_event_id, playbook_codes, target_type, target_id, channel, dedup_key, payload, status, scheduled_time, expire_time, attempts, max_attempts, create_by, create_time, update_time) values (#{triggerId}, #{agentCode}, #{action}, #{sourceEventId}, cast(coalesce(#{playbookCodes}, '[]') as jsonb), #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{channel}, #{dedupKey}, cast(coalesce(#{payload}, '{}') as jsonb), 'pending', #{scheduledTime}, #{expireTime}, 0, coalesce(#{maxAttempts}, 3), coalesce(#{createBy}, 'system'), now(), now()) on conflict (dedup_key) do nothing
mapper.update: update abr_growth_task set status = 'expired', finished_time = now(), update_time = now(), error_msg = case when attempts = 0 then '有效期内未执行（Agent 未上线或已停用）' else error_msg end where status = 'pending' and expire_time is not null and expire_time <= now()

update abr_growth_task set status = case when attempts >= max_attempts then 'failed' else 'pending' end, finished_time = case when attempts >= max_attempts then now() else null end, claim_token = null, error_msg = '执行超时（进程中断或处理过久）', update_time = now() where status = 'running' and started_time < now() - make_interval(mins => #{staleMinutes})

update abr_growth_task set status = 'running', claim_token = #{claimToken}, attempts = attempts + 1, started_time = now(), update_time = now() where task_id in ( select task_id from abr_growth_task where status = 'pending' and scheduled_time <= now() and (expire_time is null or expire_time > now()) and agent_code in #{a} order by scheduled_time, task_id limit #{limit} for update skip locked )
mapper.select: where k.claim_token = #{claimToken} and k.status = 'running' order by k.scheduled_time, k.task_id
mapper.update: update abr_growth_task set status = #{status}, result = cast(#{result} as jsonb), error_msg = coalesce(#{errorMsg}, ''), claim_token = null, finished_time = now(), update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and claim_token = #{claimToken} and status = 'running'

update abr_growth_task set status = case when attempts >= max_attempts then 'failed' else 'pending' end, finished_time = case when attempts >= max_attempts then now() else null end, scheduled_time = case when attempts >= max_attempts then scheduled_time else now() + make_interval(mins => #{delayMinutes}) end, error_msg = coalesce(#{errorMsg}, ''), claim_token = null, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and claim_token = #{claimToken} and status = 'running'

update abr_growth_task set status = 'pending', attempts = greatest(attempts - 1, 0), scheduled_time = cast(#{until} as timestamp), expire_time = case when expire_time is not null and expire_time < cast(#{until} as timestamp) then cast(#{until} as timestamp) + interval '1 hour' else expire_time end, error_msg = coalesce(#{errorMsg}, ''), claim_token = null, update_time = now() where task_id = #{taskId} and claim_token = #{claimToken} and status = 'running'

update abr_growth_task set status = 'pending', attempts = 0, scheduled_time = now(), expire_time = now() + make_interval(hours => #{ttlHours}), finished_time = null, claim_token = null, error_msg = '', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where status in ('failed', 'skipped', 'expired', 'cancelled') and task_id in #{id}
update abr_growth_task set status = 'cancelled', finished_time = now(), claim_token = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where status = 'pending' and task_id in #{id}
